title: Transfection of sgRNA Using SpCas9 Plasmids to Generate Cell Lines
author: Binnypreet Kaur
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x39fqr6
materials: Step2: Follow the protocol 7 for transfection

steps.title: Assemble RNP complexes
steps.instruction: Assemble RNP complexes using gRNA (30pmol/μl) and Cas9 (20pmol/μl) at a Cas9:gRNA ratio of 1:9 in resuspension buffer.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 10 min.
Transfer the complexes to ice until use for electroporation.
